title: Step 63-B backend and OpenAPI Cart/Checkout contract readiness
description: High-risk Stage B for Step 63. Audit canonical Cart, Checkout, Address, Shipping and Payment contracts against the frozen Step-63 Storefront journey; prove backend/OpenAPI/generated-contract readiness, identify only evidence-backed gaps, and permit scoped runtime/API correction only after fresh Graphify evidence and required Human Gate.

acceptance_criteria.description: Canonical OpenAPI, generated contracts and backend implementations for cart CRUD, quote, customer cart access/merge, addresses, shipping methods, checkout reserve/order and payment initiate/status/verify are audited against the frozen Step-63 journey.
Legacy Step-55 endpoint labels are never treated as authority when they differ from current canonical OpenAPI.
Price, stock, discount, shipping, totals, ownership, order and payment truth remain backend-authoritative and retry-sensitive mutations preserve required idempotency.
No backend/OpenAPI/runtime mutation occurs until Graphify health is FRESH/PASS with required query/path/explain evidence and the HIGH-risk Human Gate is satisfied.
Any discovered gap is repaired only inside this Task Contract scope and receives focused regression coverage plus canonical verify.
Stage 63-B canonical completion requires exact-head CI, deterministic Review, artifact-bound Lock, required Human Gate, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Step 63-B is HIGH risk. Owner has authorized continuation of Step 63 in chat, but final HUMAN approval must bind to the frozen exact head and artifact after technical/security gates are green. Direct-main write/raw merge prohibited.
